description: This Java source file defines the class DittoMongoCollectionCache, which implements a cache for MongoDB collections using Scala Futures and caffeine cache. It manages cache configuration based on provided Config and provides methods to retrieve or create collections and to invalidate cache entries.

classes.name: DittoMongoCollectionCache
classes.description: A generic cache class for MongoDB collections that manages cache configuration and collection retrieval using Scala Futures and caffeine cache.
